text: {"findings":[{"resource_address":"azurerm_mssql_database.main","doc_id":"POL-004","attribute":"name","title":"The azurerm_mssql_database.main resource changes name from \"payments\" to \"payments-v2\", which forces a replacement and can destroy the existing database data.","suggestion":"Keep the database name unchanged or confirm the data is backed up or disposable before applying the replacement."}]}
